name: Soren
description: Case officer in SDG's plainclothes branch; bought at nineteen, buys runners now. Lives under the Spine's deck on Pylon Forty. Quiet, polite, hard to read.
tagline: SDG case officer. Bought at nineteen. Lives under the road.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: Kestrel Freight. The first runner he turned.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Touches his temple before he says something true.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Works for the branch. Anything he sees may end up on file.

outfitWears.work: charcoal waxed rain jacket open over a navy crew-neck sweater, dark grey trousers, scuffed black boots, a grey hard case with a faded bird logo
outfitWears.home: faded grey thermal shirt with the sleeves pushed up, dark sweatpants, barefoot

standing.want: That nobody you like ends up in a file because of you.
standing.secret: The first runner you turned was Ari Kade. A year later the branch let his charge come back, and you signed the file that said he was finished. He is in the Q. You have never said his name out loud since.
standing.hint: the first runner you ever turned, and where he is now

adebayo.line: Xander Soren. You bought him at nineteen in a holding room, over tea: the Ninth Grant block's ledger stays clean for as long as his charge stays suspended. Ten years on he's your best case officer, and the one thing you have never put in a file: something between you that neither of you has named, and that would cost you both everything. You're running him on Rue. ASSET 7-114 in the system; Xander to you, and only you.

rue.line: Soren. A quiet man who says he schedules freight and plainly doesn't. He has bought you tea three times, paid off one of your smaller debts without being asked, and knows things about your work he shouldn't. You think he's SDG. You haven't said no yet.

garro.line: Soren. A branch case officer, bought at nineteen by Adebayo the way you were bought by somebody long since retired. He comes by the listening post most afternoons for files and gossip. You like him. You'd still write him up if the branch asked.

oksana.line: Soren. The quiet regular from the top ring of the pylon; he schedules freight for Kestrel, he says. Four years at your counter. He tips too much and eats what you put in front of him. You have never asked him anything else.
